generation: OpenAI image generation; actual runtime raster assets

assets.brief: Generated dark cathedral menu scene, armored greathelm knight at left, red eclipse, quiet carved stone alcove at right for existing title and buttons.
Generated silver and ivory gothic player health frame with helmet crest, transparent meter opening, carved ruby button plates. Only isolated frame and selected plate used.
Generated six matching knight death poses: wounded, kneeling, bracing hand, collapse, fallen, still. No gore. Extracted with uniform scale and floor anchor.
Generated isolated silver helmet pawn with red banner and gold winged ruby selection seal on transparent background.

processing: prepare_art.py and extract_death.py: crop transparent cells, resize for PSP, embed RGBA and RGB565 data. No line-art replacement for requested redesigns.
font: DejaVu Serif Bold, bundled license in fonts; rasterized 7/8/9/10px glyphs. 7px used only if a long hand title needs it.
